```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
store <- here::here("_targets")

cfg    <- tar_read(cfg,    store = store)
adsl   <- tar_read(adsl,   store = store)
rdeff  <- tar_read(rdeff,  store = store)
rdmi   <- tar_read(rdmi,   store = store)
rdtte  <- tar_read(rdtte,  store = store)
rdsub  <- tar_read(rdsub,  store = store)
rddsc  <- tar_read(rddsc,  store = store)

mode_sham <- !identical(cfg$mode, "true")

fmt_pct <- function(n, pct) ifelse(is.na(pct), as.character(n),
                                   sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", n, pct))
fmt_ci  <- function(est, lcl, ucl, d = 2)
  ifelse(is.na(est), "",
         sprintf(paste0("%.", d, "f (%.", d, "f, %.", d, "f)"), est, lcl, ucl))
fmt_p   <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", format.pval(p, digits = 3, eps = 1e-4))
fmt_yn  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", ifelse(x, "yes", "no"))
# fixed-sequence NI/superiority conclusion as one label (SAP 2.1-2.2):
# superiority is only claimed once non-inferiority is shown
fmt_concl <- function(ni_concl, sup_concl) dplyr::case_when(
  is.na(ni_concl)      ~ "",
  ni_concl & sup_concl ~ "Non-inferior, superior",
  ni_concl             ~ "Non-inferior",
  .default             = "Not concluded"
)
fmt_p2 <- function(p_ni, p_sup) {
  a <- fmt_p(p_ni); b <- fmt_p(p_sup)
  ifelse(a == "" & b == "", "", paste0(a, ifelse(b == "", "", paste0("; ", b))))
}
# a model-convergence note, dropped when it is only the expected "singular
# fit" (the anon copy has cluster SD ~ 0 by construction, item 42) so a
# genuine warning on real data still surfaces
fmt_note <- function(note) ifelse(is.na(note) | note %in% c("", "singular fit"), "", note)
# adds a Note column only when something beyond the expected singular fit
# needs flagging, so the column disappears from a fully-clean table
maybe_note <- function(df, note_raw) {
  ns <- fmt_note(note_raw)
  if (any(nzchar(ns))) dplyr::mutate(df, Note = ns) else df
}
# reference / intervention arm labels (reference = first TRT01P level):
# "WHO partograph" and "LCG" throughout (cfg$arms)
arms <- levels(adsl$TRT01P)
# study period (FORMPER / PERIODC values) as shown in the tables
per_lab <- c(setNames(vapply(cfg$arms, `[[`, "", "arm"), vapply(cfg$arms, `[[`, "", "raw")),
             transition = "Transition")
per_order <- unname(per_lab[c("control", "transition", "intervention")])
# column headers naming the arms
ev_nm  <- sprintf("Events (%s / %s)", arms[1], arms[2])
rk_ref <- paste("Risk,", arms[1]); rk_int <- paste("Risk,", arms[2])
margin_pp <- 100 * cfg$analysis$ni_margin
k0 <- cfg$analysis$tte$origin_cm
H  <- cfg$analysis$tte$horizon

# a kable that never overflows the page width in the PDF: a native LaTeX
# table (so short numeric columns are not force-wrapped mid-digit by
# pandoc's proportional column widths, SAP report review 2026-09-15), scaled
# down only if it would still be wider than the page; landscape = TRUE turns
# the (portrait) page it lands on sideways first, for the widest tables.
# Built as a single raw-latex block so it cannot straddle Quarto's own
# per-chunk div wrapping. HTML is unchanged.
rkable <- function(df, ..., landscape = FALSE) {
  if (!knitr::is_latex_output()) return(knitr::kable(df, ...))
  tab <- knitr::kable(df, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "", ...)
  body <- paste0("\\begin{adjustbox}{max width=\\linewidth}\n", tab, "\n\\end{adjustbox}\n")
  if (landscape) body <- paste0("\\begin{landscape}\n", body, "\\end{landscape}\n")
  knitr::asis_output(body)
}
```

```{r banner}
#| output: asis
if (mode_sham) cat(
  "::: {.callout-warning title=\"MOCK-UP — sham data\"}\n",
  "This report is built in `sham` mode on the **anonymised** export ",
  "(`", cfg$export, "_anon`). The study period (record-key prefix), hospital, ",
  "time of birth and outcomes are permuted or shifted independently, so every ",
  "treatment effect below is noise **by construction**. The mock-up ",
  "validates the code and layout, not the estimates. Single-variable rates ",
  "and within-woman labour timings are real.\n",
  ":::\n", sep = "")
```

# Introduction

NORWELCG is a stepped-wedge cluster-randomised non-inferiority trial of the WHO
Labour Care Guide (LCG) versus the WHO partograph in `r cfg$sw$n_steps` steps of
`r cfg$sw$step_weeks` weeks across `r dplyr::n_distinct(adsl$SITEID)` Norwegian
delivery units, inclusion `r cfg$sw$start` to `r cfg$sw$end` (by time of birth).
The primary endpoint is intrapartum caesarean section; the LCG is non-inferior
if the upper limit of the 95% confidence interval for the risk difference
(LCG − WHO partograph) lies below +`r margin_pp` percentage points, and
superior if it also lies below 0 (SAP §2.1).

All binary endpoints are analysed with a binomial GLMM (logit link, random
cluster intercept, fixed effects for treatment, time interval and the SAP §4.1.3
covariates — Robson group, maternal age, pre-pregnancy BMI, height, birth weight,
gestational age); risks and differences are population-averaged by
G-computation integrating over the random cluster effect, with delta-method
standard errors. The study period is given by the eCRF (the prefix of the
record key: CTR, TRAN, INT), which each hospital changed at its crossover date
in the randomised schedule; the transition periods are excluded
from the primary analysis set (PAS). The time interval is the 5-week step of
the time of birth, steps starting at 08:00. The primary endpoint counts all
caesarean sections from 4 cm in both periods; amniotomy, oxytocin and epidural
are counted whatever the cervical dilatation.

All analyses follow the final signed version of the statistical analysis plan
v1.0 of 14 October 2026.

# Analysis sets

```{r popflow}
adsl |>
  summarise(
    `FAS` = n(),
    `PAS` = sum(PASFL == "Y"),
    `VDS` = sum(VDSFL == "Y"),
    .by = FORMPER
  ) |>
  mutate(FORMPER = factor(per_lab[FORMPER], per_order)) |>
  arrange(FORMPER) |>
  rename(`Study period` = FORMPER) |>
  rkable()
```

Births by stepped-wedge time interval and study period:

```{r stepperiod}
adsl |>
  mutate(FORMPER = factor(per_lab[FORMPER], per_order)) |>
  count(STEPN, FORMPER) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = FORMPER, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  rename(`Time interval` = STEPN) |>
  rkable()
```

Period by the randomised schedule (hospital × step of birth) versus the period
of the eCRF, which defines the treatment (blinded-review check;
on real data the two agree apart from women in labour at a change of period):

```{r formcheck}
adsl |>
  count(`Scheduled period` = factor(per_lab[PERIODC], per_order),
        `eCRF period` = factor(per_lab[FORMPER], per_order)) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = `eCRF period`, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  rkable()
```

# Baseline characteristics (PAS)

```{r basecat}
rddsc$baseline_cat |>
  mutate(label = ifelse(duplicated(label), "", label)) |>
  transmute(Characteristic = label, Category = category,
            !!arms[1] := fmt_pct(n_ref, pct_ref),
            !!arms[2] := fmt_pct(n_int, pct_int)) |>
  rkable()
```

```{r basecont}
rddsc$baseline_cont |>
  transmute(Characteristic = label, Treatment = TRT01P, N = n,
            `Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean, sd),
            `Median [Q1, Q3]` = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]", median, q1, q3),
            Missing = n_miss) |>
  rkable()
```

# Primary analysis — intrapartum caesarean section

Primary: PAS, all caesarean sections from 4 cm in both periods. Sensitivity
analyses keep the estimand; supplementary analyses change one attribute (SAP
§4.1.4–4.1.5): SUPP1 counts the transition periods as WHO partograph, SUPP2 lets
the effect depend on the time since the LCG was taken into use.

```{r primary}
d_primary <- rdeff |> filter(PARAMCD == "ICS")
d_primary |>
  transmute(
    Analysis = analysis, Population = population,
    Contrast = contrast, N = n,
    !!ev_nm := sprintf("%d / %d", ev_ref, ev_int),
    !!rk_ref := sprintf("%.3f", risk_ref),
    !!rk_int := sprintf("%.3f", risk_int),
    `RD, pp (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(100 * rd, 100 * rd_lcl, 100 * rd_ucl),
    `RR (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(rr, rr_lcl, rr_ucl),
    `p (NI; superiority)` = fmt_p2(p_ni, p_sup),
    Conclusion = fmt_concl(ni_concl, sup_concl)
  ) |>
  maybe_note(d_primary$note) |>
  rkable(landscape = TRUE)
```

# Secondary endpoints — dichotomous

Complete case unless stated; cord pH by multiple imputation. PAS, except
episiotomy and OASIS (grade 3a–3c or 4) in the vaginal delivery set (VDS).
Amniotomy, oxytocin and epidural are counted whatever the cervical dilatation.

All models are the binomial GLMM of the Introduction; "MI" marks the
multiply-imputed endpoint (cord pH).

```{r secondary}
d_sec <- bind_rows(rdeff |> filter(analysis == "SECONDARY"),
                   rdmi  |> filter(analysis == "SECONDARY"))
d_sec |>
  transmute(
    Endpoint = PARAM, Population = population,
    MI = ifelse(grepl("MI \\(", model), sub(".*(MI \\(m = [0-9]+\\)).*", "\\1", model), ""),
    N = n,
    `Not recorded` = ifelse(is.na(n_miss), "", format(n_miss, big.mark = ",")),
    !!ev_nm := sprintf("%s / %s", round(ev_ref), round(ev_int)),
    !!rk_ref := sprintf("%.3f", risk_ref),
    !!rk_int := sprintf("%.3f", risk_int),
    `RD, pp (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(100 * rd, 100 * rd_lcl, 100 * rd_ucl),
    `RR (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(rr, rr_lcl, rr_ucl)
  ) |>
  maybe_note(d_sec$note) |>
  rkable(landscape = TRUE)
```

# Time from `r k0` cm to vaginal delivery

Restricted mean time without vaginal delivery during the first `r H` hours
after `r k0` cm: Y = min(T, `r H` h) after a vaginal delivery and `r H` h after
a caesarean section (composite strategy; PAS). Linear mixed model (random cluster, time interval, covariates);
the time of reaching `r k0` cm is multiply imputed from the labour-curve model
where no examination found `r k0` cm, and the estimates are combined by Rubin's
rules. Negative differences favour the LCG.

```{r tte}
tr <- rdtte$results
tr |>
  mutate(fmt = ifelse(unit == "proportion", 100, 1)) |>
  transmute(
    Measure = measure, Analysis = analysis, Set = population,
    !!arms[1] := sprintf(ifelse(unit == "proportion", "%.3f", "%.2f"), est_ref),
    !!arms[2] := sprintf(ifelse(unit == "proportion", "%.3f", "%.2f"), est_int),
    `Difference (95% CI)` = paste0(fmt_ci(fmt * estimate, fmt * lcl, fmt * ucl),
                                   ifelse(unit == "proportion", " pp", " h"))
  ) |>
  maybe_note(tr$note) |>
  rkable(landscape = TRUE)
```

N = `r tr$n[1]` (vaginal deliveries `r tr$n_vd[1]`; time of reaching `r k0` cm
imputed for `r tr$n_t0_imputed[1]`; m = `r tr$m[1]` imputed datasets). SENS2
uses heteroscedasticity-consistent (HC3) standard errors; the components and the
supportive analyses are presented alongside, not as separate treatment effects.

Cumulative incidence of vaginal delivery by hours since `r k0` cm: the empirical
proportion delivered vaginally (no censoring), evaluated each minute and
averaged over the imputed datasets; descriptive, not adjusted for time interval.
The plateau is the proportion delivered vaginally:

```{r cif}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-alt: "Cumulative proportion of women delivered vaginally (y) by hours since 4 cm cervical dilatation (x), one step curve per treatment."
series <- setNames(c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834"), arms)
surface <- "#fcfcfb"
ggplot(rdtte$cif, aes(hours, cif, colour = TRT01P)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = series, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(paste0("Hours since ", k0, " cm"), breaks = seq(0, H, 6)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Delivered vaginally", labels = scales::percent,
                     limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = surface, colour = NA),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#e1e0d9", linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "#52514e"),
        axis.title = element_text(colour = "#52514e"),
        legend.text = element_text(colour = "#0b0b0b"),
        legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left")
```

Observed times (descriptive), women with an examination at `r k0` cm who
delivered vaginally — no imputation:

```{r t0obs}
rddsc$t0obs |>
  transmute(Treatment = TRT01P, N = n,
            `Median [Q1, Q3], h` = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", median, q1, q3),
            `90th pct, h` = sprintf("%.2f", p90)) |>
  rkable()
```

# Supplementary analyses of secondary endpoints

Composite strategy for the vaginal-birth endpoints (episiotomy, OASIS):
caesarean section counted as no event, PAS.

```{r supplementary}
bind_rows(rdeff |> filter(analysis == "SUPPLEMENTARY"),
          rdmi  |> filter(analysis == "SUPPLEMENTARY")) |>
  transmute(
    Endpoint = PARAM, Population = population, N = n,
    !!rk_ref := sprintf("%.3f", risk_ref),
    !!rk_int := sprintf("%.3f", risk_int),
    `RD, pp (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(100 * rd, 100 * rd_lcl, 100 * rd_ucl),
    `RR (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(rr, rr_lcl, rr_ucl)
  ) |>
  rkable()
```

# Subgroup analysis — Robson group

Exploratory (SAP §8.2): the primary model with a treatment × Robson group
interaction, risk difference within each group by G-computation; groups with
fewer than `r rdsub$min_events[1]` intrapartum caesarean sections (pooled) are
combined. Likelihood-ratio test of the interaction:
p = `r fmt_p(rdsub$p_interaction[1])`. Not adjusted for multiplicity; no
non-inferiority conclusion within subgroups.

```{r subgroup}
rdsub |>
  transmute(
    `Robson group` = group, N = n,
    !!ev_nm := sprintf("%d / %d", ev_ref, ev_int),
    !!rk_ref := ifelse(is.na(risk_ref), "", sprintf("%.3f", risk_ref)),
    !!rk_int := ifelse(is.na(risk_int), "", sprintf("%.3f", risk_int)),
    `RD, pp (95% CI)` = fmt_ci(100 * rd, 100 * rd_lcl, 100 * rd_ucl)
  ) |>
  maybe_note(rdsub$note) |>
  rkable()
```

`r if (any(nzchar(rdsub$groups_combined))) paste0("Combined: ", rdsub$groups_combined[nzchar(rdsub$groups_combined)], ".") else ""`

# Descriptive endpoints (PAS)

Presented descriptively; no models are fitted. Each endpoint among the women it
applies to: the caesarean sections for the CS characteristics (the second twin's
for a CS of the second twin only); the women with continuous monitoring for its
type. Shared decision making for operative delivery is recorded on the LCG form
only and is shown for the LCG period; the follow-up items among the women whose
gate question was yes.

```{r descriptive}
#| output: asis
desc <- rddsc$endpoints
lcg_only <- "SHARED DECISION MAKING"
for (grp in unique(desc$PARCAT2)) {
  cat("\n## ", tools::toTitleCase(tolower(grp)), "\n\n", sep = "")
  tab <- desc |>
    filter(PARCAT2 == grp) |>
    mutate(PARAM = ifelse(duplicated(PARAM), "", PARAM)) |>
    transmute(Endpoint = PARAM, Category = category,
              !!arms[1] := fmt_pct(n_ref, pct_ref),
              !!arms[2] := fmt_pct(n_int, pct_int))
  if (grp %in% lcg_only) tab <- tab[, names(tab) != arms[1]]
  cat(rkable(tab), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Numeric endpoints and auxiliaries

Cord gases, Apgar scores and estimated blood loss (primary analysis set).

```{r numdesc}
rddsc$numeric |>
  mutate(PARAM = ifelse(duplicated(PARAM), "", PARAM)) |>
  transmute(Variable = PARAM, Treatment = TRT01P, N = n, Missing = n_miss,
            `Mean (SD)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean, sd),
            `Median [Q1, Q3]` = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", median, q1, q3)) |>
  rkable()
```

## Cervical examinations

Hours from each examination to delivery by the dilatation found (examinations
with 0–72 h to delivery).

```{r exams}
rddsc$exams |>
  transmute(`Dilatation (cm)` = CMN, Treatment = TRT01P, Examinations = n, Women = women,
            `Median [Q1, Q3], h` = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", median, q1, q3)) |>
  rkable()
```
